attempts.summary: Repaired and deployed the UDP collector on node1. Valid node2 datagrams are durably appended to readings.csv, duplicate meter/sequence pairs are ignored across collector and node restarts, malformed datagrams go to malformed.log without stopping collection, and the original west,1,42 reading remains intact. Both nodes were rebooted sequentially and recovered with changed boot identities. AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 were preserved.
